newsitem.title: USA: Roanoke expects improved Q4, FY earnings.
newsitem.headline: Roanoke expects improved Q4, FY earnings.

text.p: Roanoke Electric Steel Corp said Tuesday it expects its higher selling prices and margins to continue, and it expects improved earnings for the fourth quarter and fiscal year.
The company said its improvement in results for the third quarter ended July 31 was mainly due to higher shipment levels and margins for mill products.
The improved margins were attributable to increased selling prices and lower costs due to the efficiencies of increased production.
The company reported earnings per share for the third quarter of $0.57 compared with $0.39 for the same period a year ago. Sales for the quarter were $68.8 million compared with $61.5 million.
